jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
LRE (Leeward Renewable Energy) is forging an American energy future with integrity, innovation, and positive impact. Born in Texas in 2003, we own and operate over 30 utility-scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects in local communities across the United States, totaling 4 gigawatts (GW) of generating capacity.

LRE continues to help meet increased U.S. energy demand through our robust pipeline of new projects every year. Domestic jobs and manufacturing are fundamental to our full-lifecycle approach to projects, along with a long-term ownership model and a company culture dedicated to our community partners and protecting the natural environment.

Job Summary:

LRE is currently seeking an experienced Project Manager. The Project Manager will be Leeward’s lead during the late-stage development (post financial investment decision), construction, and commissioning of Leeward Energy renewable energy projects, which may include solar, solar/BESS, stand-alone BESS, and wind energy projects. The Project Manager will lead a team of internal stakeholders, site-based construction management professionals, safety officer(s), and inspectors while ensuring safety, quality, contract, and financial milestones are achieved. This role will be remote based with monthly travel required (min. 25% travel).

Essential Functions:

Provide leadership in project risk assessments and risk mitigation strategies.
Provide leadership in stakeholder engagement and reporting to ensure that project stakeholders are properly informed and accountable for workstreams and work products.
Promote and ensure compliance with LRE safety standards and promote LRE safety culture at all times, specifically ensuring that all BESS/Module/Turbine Suppliers (or other owner supplied equipment providers), BOP Contractor(s) and their subcontractors, and other contractors accessing a project site are adhering to project site safety plan.
Must have a strong understanding of project budgets & schedules and be able to provide proactive oversight of project budgets, cashflow needs, and other financial related workstreams.
Lead and manage Contractors and Suppliers contractual obligations including oversight and mitigation of change orders and other financial risks on a project.
Lead a cross-functional team after hand-off from Development to ensure oversight and close-out of action items occur during the RFP, Contracting, Construction, and Commercial Operations phases of a project. Cross-functional teams are likely to include (at a minimum) Regulatory, Development, Safety, Environmental, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Utility/Transmission, Originations, Senior Leadership, and Legal. A candidate must be capable of leading such a complex team to ensure a project is built in accordance with regulatory and environmental compliance, contract, plans and specifications, financial, and safety requirements.
Interface with all project team members, tracking issues and facilitating and expediting solutions. 
Responsible for maintaining clear and concise communications, keeping accurate records and thorough documentation throughout all phases of the project such that all stakeholders are informed and knowledgeable of key decisions points during the course of a project.
Identify, deploy, and manage a high-performing team needed to monitor onsite construction and commissioning work for owner renewable energy projects.
As challenges or change conditions present themselves, a candidate must be able to actively weigh the various stakeholder viewpoints and ensure timely and informed resolution is achieved.
Track, manage, update, and submit internal weekly and monthly project reports
Interface with development team members on projects in late-stage development to ensure that project execution support is provided such that a project can move into the RFP/Contracting phases (e.g. constructability analysis, EPC estimates/ROMs, financial, permitting support, other items, etc.).
Support PPA and LGIA negotiations and execution as requested

Qualifications:

Strong understanding of construction safety requirements. OSHA 30-Hour qualification preferred.
Experience managing construction QA/QC programs on renewable energy projects.
A minimum of 6 years of renewable energy experience, or have completed not less than 3 wind, BESS, and/or solar farm construction projects as a project manager from EPC Contracting through Commercial Operation. Desired experience to include in-depth knowledge of at least three of the following: civil construction, structural/foundation construction, electrical construction, turbine erection/solar module assembly, testing & commissioning, preparing for and supporting various project financial/tax equity closes, and achieving utility commercial operation designations.
Understanding of and experience managing renewable energy project contracts including EPC/BOP, testing & commissioning, turbine, module, and/or battery supplier agreements.
Extensive project management skills with a track record of achieving success on complex projects.
Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiations skills.
Strong PC skills, Microsoft Office suite of applications, general software proficiency, and a sound understanding of project scheduling including critical path analysis, successor/predecessor analysis, change analysis, etc.
Strong managerial/leadership skills.
Bachelor’s degree in: Construction Management, Engineering, Finance/Accounting, or Business Management. Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
Must have the ability to manage teams effectively in high stress situations while obtaining consensus and repeatedly overcoming challenges.
Flexibility to work at locations across North America for up to ~25% of year

Physical Demands:

Able to work in high stress environments
Ability to sit for extended periods of time working at a computer
Ability to occasionally lift, push, pull, carry items up to 50 lbs. in weight
Able to work in demanding physical and inclement weather conditions
Position will require sitting for long periods of time

Applicants must have current authorization to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for an employment visa now or in the future
. Employer visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Leeward Management Services, LLC is committed to employing a diverse workforce and provides equal employment opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Leeward Renewable Energy (LRE) does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting vendors or employment agencies. Only recruiting vendors with a current, signed agreement in place with LRE are authorized to submit resumes for specific, requested positions. All unsolicited resumes and candidate profiles submitted to LRE, or any LRE employee, without an active agreement or written request from LRE’s HR Department, will be considered property of LRE. LRE will not be responsible for any fees or expenses associated with unsolicited resumes or candidates submitted in this manner.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager, Interconnection Projects & Grid Infrastructure Delivery
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

This organization operates in the energy sector, focusing on delivering affordable and reliable energy solutions to industries, data centers, and the electric grid. It addresses challenges in energy supply by utilizing thermal battery technology that converts low-cost electricity into continuous heat and power, avoiding reliance on constrained critical minerals and lengthy construction times. The company emphasizes mission-driven growth, fostering a diverse and collaborative team dedicated to advancing clean, low-cost energy technologies.

About the Opportunity:

The SR. PROJECT MANAGER, INTERCONNECTION PROJECTS & GRID INFRASTRUCTURE DELIVERY is responsible for overseeing the delivery of interconnection engineering, SCADA and telemetry systems, and grid infrastructure for thermal energy storage projects across multiple regional transmission organizations. This role ensures technical and schedule compliance by managing consultants, engineers, and contractors, directly influencing project execution and advancing the organization’s portfolio within key energy markets.

Responsibilities:

Manage engineering firms through design phases including substations, switchyards, and equipment specifications.
Ensure designs comply with interconnection studies and agreements, addressing changes impacting cost or schedule.
Coordinate utility and transmission owner interactions on network upgrades and facility scopes.
Oversee interfaces with Owner’s Engineers and EPC firms, managing procurement and construction delivery.
Develop and manage statements of work, RFPs, vendor selection, contracts, budgets, and change control.
Maintain vendor management tools such as SOW templates and qualification standards.
Define and manage SCADA, telemetry, and metering engineering scopes and contracts.
Lead innovative measurement approaches and ensure compliance with RTO testing requirements.
Maintain integrated project schedules, track deliverables, and coordinate cross-functional teams.
Communicate project status, risks, and escalations to leadership and stakeholders.

Requirements:

Over 6 years of experience managing capital projects in energy infrastructure including generation, storage, substations, or transmission.
Proficiency in designing and procuring interconnection configurations and coordinating with utilities.
Ability to assess technical documentation for completeness and accuracy.
Experience with SCADA, telemetry, protection and control, or substation automation at utility scale.
Understanding of interconnection studies, agreements, and associated facility construction.
Strong technical writing and project management skills, capable of handling multiple concurrent projects.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Salary range: $163,000 USD - $200,000 USD annually.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Recruiting Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Recruiting Strategy & Enablement Team is dedicated to enhancing the quality and efficiency of Stripe's Recruiting function. By executing a suite of strategic projects and programs, we optimize the caliber and productivity of our global recruiting team. Our focus includes driving programmatic initiatives, facilitating data-informed decision-making, and steering change management to enable robust business engagement. We are looking for a talented project manager to join our team.

What you’ll do

As a Project Manager on the Recruiting Strategy & Enablement team, you'll own strategic programs end-to-end — from scoping and stakeholder alignment through execution, enablement, and measurement. You'll partner closely with Global Recruiting Leads, Hiring Managers, and cross-functional teams to ship initiatives that improve recruiting quality, efficiency, and compliance at a global scale. Day-to-day, you'll balance long-running portfolio work with fast-moving priorities that require you to ramp quickly and execute with minimal oversight.

Responsibilities

Own and steer strategic programs' objectives and key result areas, including tracking and reporting metrics and overall program management
Lead change management initiatives within our recruiting teams and collaborate with partners to facilitate seamless transitions
Drive enablement strategies that support program adoption, including comms plans, FAQs, and stakeholder-facing resources
Identify and implement operational improvements across recruiting programs and processes, maximizing their effectiveness and efficiency
Design training guides and educational materials to enhance the skill set of recruiters
Collaborate closely with Global Recruiting Leads and Hiring Managers to pinpoint and execute high-priority initiatives that elevate our recruiting efforts
Manage portfolio-level governance: run SteerCos, track workstream DRIs, synthesize progress, and report to leadership on program health and outcomes
Navigate global regulatory and compliance requirements that impact recruiting processes (e.g., pay transparency, pre-employment checks, data privacy), partnering with legal, HR compliance, and People Partners
Absorb emerging work as priorities shift — such as hiring sprints, organizational transitions, or rapid-turnaround projects — with minimal ramp time

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Proven expertise in program, change, and project management within a dynamic, global, high-growth environment
Experience owning and launching strategic programs that drive measurable quality and efficiency improvements in a People or HR function
Experience building, launching, or managing AI-powered programs or assessments — not just personal AI tool use, but owning the strategy, piloting, and rollout of AI-enabled workflows or products
Demonstrated initiative, autonomy, and critical thinking with keen attention to detail
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across multiple teams

Preferred Qualifications

Ability and willingness to attend to work matters outside normal business hours on an as-needed basis (this role supports a global team, so flexibility to adjust your working schedule to connect with counterparts in different time zones is preferable)
Functional experience in recruiting, with a minimum of three years in the field
Ability to interpret recruiting metrics, build light reporting or dashboards, and use data to diagnose problems and make recommendations
Familiarity with recruiting technology ecosystems (e.g., ATS, CRM, scheduling tools, assessment platforms) and comfort learning new systems quickly

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is a global leader in professional mobile communications systems, backed by a rich heritage of technological innovation and an extensive international footprint. Our core business focuses on designing and deploying mission-critical digital mobile communication solutions for government and public safety organizations worldwide.

The Federal Project Manager will join the Motorola Solutions Federal Division, directly supporting Department of Defense (DoD) initiatives. This role offers flexible remote work from anywhere within the United States with proximity to a major airport, requiring 50% or more domestic travel.

Job Description

Oversees the deployment and implementation of Motorola Solutions products and service offerings.
Leads cross-functional teams dedicated to launching new solutions or upgrading existing systems.
Directs the entire project lifecycle from initiation through completion or handoff, monitoring performance metrics throughout.
Guarantees delivery within established timelines, budget constraints, and quality standards.
Formulates and executes comprehensive project plans encompassing contractual requirements, including design reviews, timelines, system configuration, installation, training, and testing.
Oversees subcontractor operations by drafting detailed statements of work, negotiating purchase order outcomes, organizing installation schedules, and ensuring full compliance with project specifications.
Manages, tracks, and projects financial elements, including budget allocations and revenue goals.
Monitors and maintains control over equipment inventory.
Drafts technical proposals, change orders, and bids for system integration initiatives as required.
Engages in project reviews and status meetings, ensuring clear communication of progress to stakeholders.
Prepares comprehensive documentation for both internal reviews and external customer updates.
Applies established project management frameworks to maximize operational efficiency.
Inspires and guides project team members to drive high performance.
Supports the creation of strategic plans and business approaches to capitalize on new opportunities.
Consistently secures favorable customer satisfaction ratings upon contract completion.

Skills/Experience

PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of success in deploying IT communication systems.
Prior experience administering and delivering government and public sector contracts.
Background in technical positions such as Project Lead, Engineer, or Senior Technician is highly desirable.
Demonstrated proficiency in advanced project management disciplines, including risk mitigation, financial oversight, project planning, team leadership, dispute resolution, and stakeholder management.
Exceptional verbal and written communication, strategic planning, and negotiation capabilities.
Skilled in preparing thorough progress reports and delivering executive-level presentations to clients.
Hands-on expertise in developing Statements of Work (SOWs) and directing vendor and subcontractor performance.
A history of accurately predicting financial outcomes and achieving key revenue targets.
Adept at leading complex initiatives in a remote environment.
Strong proficiency with Google Suite Applications, Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and MS Project.

Candidate Requirements

Must reside in the contiguous United States with convenient access to a major airport.
Prepared to travel across the continental U.S. at least 50% of the time.
Capable of securing and maintaining a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Public Trust Clearance.
Eligible to satisfy all background screening criteria mandated by government clients.

Target Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's Degree OR 5+ years of experience in one of the following: LMR, Engineering, Project Management, Technical Services, Government, Military or Public Safety.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.
Must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain necessary security clearance as required by government contracts.

Travel Requirements

Over 50%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits Include

Incentive Bonus Plans
Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
401K with Company Match
10 Paid Holidays
Generous Paid Time Off Packages
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Parental & Family Leave
and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

jobs.title: APAC CBD/CDD Product Launch & Market Readiness Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent's Cell Analysis, Genomics and Pathology portfolio continues to expand across Asia Pacific, and bringing each new product to market means bringing together regulatory registration, technical enablement and a channel network ready to sell and support it — in every country, on a schedule.

This is a newly created regional position that owns exactly that. You will lead the country-level execution of new product introductions across APAC region: building the launch plan market by market, driving regulatory readiness with local Regulatory Affairs and specialist registration partners, and preparing our channel partners to demonstrate, sell and support new products from day one.

You will work across Global Product Launch, Regulatory Affairs, Regional Technical Solution Specialists, Country commercial teams and channel partners, coordinating a critical path that runs from global product readiness through to first customer adoption.

In this role you will:

Manage the delivery of integrated, multi-country new product launch programs, from global product readiness through regulatory clearance, technical and channel readiness, market activation and first customer adoption.
Determine the overall program plan, budget, structure, schedule and resourcing for each priority launch, market by market — registration route, licence holder or agent, documentation and localisation requirements, enablement, demo instruments and target activation dates.
Drive and deliver results according to agreed project scope, cost, quality and timeline milestones.
Take accountability for risk assessment, identifying critical-path dependencies early and communicating them clearly to stakeholders at country, regional and global level.
Serve as the direct contact between channel partners, specialist regulatory partners and Agilent project stakeholders.
Support channel partners in implementing launch readiness: product and application training, competency certification, demo instrument allocation and installation, ordering and inventory access, and target account planning.
Identify, qualify, onboard and manage third-party regulatory and registration partners to agreed deliverables and service levels.
Track program costs and expenses against defined metrics, communicate deviations, and monitor launch performance against the business case.
Own the costing of country registration and readiness programs, including third-party scopes of work, and ensure delivery within approved budgets.
Build and maintain relationships with channel partners, regulatory partners and country commercial organizations.
Establish launch governance for the region: a single readiness view by product and country, with clear owners and escalation paths.

Partner contracts, pricing and commercial performance management remain with country commercial and channel management. Regulatory strategy, submissions and regulatory decisions remain with Regulatory Affairs. This position owns the program execution that brings these together.

The role requires approximately up to 40% travel across India and the broader APAC markets.

Must consent to participate and meet Agilent approved customer/vendor credentialing requirements necessary to gain access to customer sites. Requirements may include, but are not limited to, proof of identification, proof of certification to perform the work required, and customer health and safety requirements.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a life science, engineering or related discipline.
5–8 years of experience in product launch, commercial, channel partner management within medical diagnostics — in vitro diagnostics or laboratory instrumentation.
Product launches owned end to end, from plan through to first sale.
Strong project management discipline: critical paths, gates, dependency mapping and risk control. PMP, Lean or an equivalent structured methodology.
Multi-country delivery experience across India and APAC markets, with the credibility to operate across distinct regulatory and commercial environments.
Experience directing external vendors, consultants or agencies to deliverables and service levels.
Willingness to travel approximately 40% within the region.

Preferred

Experience with cell analysis, genomics or pathology product lines.
Commercial enablement at scale: partner training, competency certification and demo fleet planning across an indirect channel.
Working knowledge of diagnostic instrument regulatory pathways, including CDSCO and ASEAN regimes, as an informed program manager working alongside regulatory specialists.
MBA from a leading business school, or a comparable postgraduate business qualification.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (PMO)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Privia Health™ is a technology-driven, national physician enablement company that collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices, improve patient experiences, and reward doctors for delivering high-value care in both in-person and virtual settings. The Privia Platform is led by top industry talent and exceptional physician leadership, and consists of scalable operations and end-to-end, cloud-based technology that reduces unnecessary healthcare costs, achieves better outcomes, and improves the health of patients and the well-being of providers.

Job Description

The Technical Project Manager is a key member of the Project Management Office (PMO) team. This role manages key projects and drives process improvement across Privia teams. The Technical Project Manager partners with members of product and technical teams to deliver project and programmatic outcomes. The Technical Project Manager will plan, execute, close out, and monitor projects - all while escalating risks, blockers, and issues. This role emphasizes supporting technical teams, drives project execution and aligning their portfolio of projects to high priority technical roadmaps. This role will partner closely with Product teams to ensure successful execution of project and measurable outcomes.

Essential Job Duties

Lead, coordinate, and manage activity between Privia technical and non-technical team stakeholders.
Directly manage multiple projects simultaneously, and assist in a portfolio of projects owned by Associates & others around Privia.
Create and manage detailed project plans and communicate status to the project sponsors, management teams, and leaders at every level of the organization.
Prepare and distribute project artifacts, including delivery/project plans, success metrics/KPIs.
Assist in the development and implementation of project & technical quality assurance processes.
Act as a bridge between technical and business teams, ensuring alignment on project priorities.
Leverage Privia and PMO ROI models for technical projects.
Coordinate tracking and communicating the progress of AI projects through existing AI governance channels, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and business objectives.
Leverage a deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle in order to foster effective project execution.

Interpersonal Skills & Attributes

Ability to perform a variety of duties and demonstrate organizational skills from planning to execution of tasks and projects
Team approach to working with others and solving complex problems through collaboration
Ability to identify & escalate risks
Effectively manage meetings and conversations with a diverse group of internal & external stakeholders
Exceptional organizational skills & attention to detail
Process oriented with the ability to drive a project to completion
Self-directed and resourceful with a bias towards action
Strong background in conducting gap analysis, process optimization, and implementing governance structures.
Proven ability to work collaboratively across technical, clinical, and operational teams to achieve business goals.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into actionable solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of technical project management experience
1+ years of remote work experience
Proficiency with project management tools preferred (e.g. Monday.com, Smartsheet, JIRA)
Knowledgeable of medical terminology preferred
Experience with data collection, reporting, and document management preferred
Must comply with HIPAA rules and regulations
Experience with ROI modeling and forecasting of technical projects
Familiarity with tech sprint cycles, IT release management and AI/automation initiatives
Experience using scrum and Kanban methodology
PMP, CSM, or PMI-ACP preferred

The salary range for this role is $105,000.00 to $125,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs) . This role is also eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 15% & Restricted Stock Units. The base pay offered will be determined based on relevant factors such as experience, education, and geographic location.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

﻿Technical Requirements (for remote workers only, not applicable for onsite/in office work):

In order to successfully work remotely, supporting our patients and providers, we require a minimum of 5 MBPS for Download Speed and 3 MBPS for the Upload Speed. This should be acquired prior to the start of your employment. The best measure of your internet speed is to use online speed tests like https://www.speedtest.net/. This gives you an update as to how fast data transfer is with your internet connection and if it meets the minimum speed requirements. Work with your internet provider if you have questions about your connection. Employees who regularly work from home offices are eligible for expense reimbursement to offset this cost.

Privia Health is committed to creating and fostering a work environment that allows and encourages you to bring your whole self to work. We understand that healthcare is local and we are better when our people are a reflection of the communities that we serve. Our goal is to encourage people to pursue all opportunities regardless of their age, color, national origin, physical or mental (dis)ability, race, religion, gender, sex, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an MSSP Project Manager, you will be tasked with driving project management across SentinelOne's MSSP business, from MSSP product transition strategies to key strategic programs and special projects. You will join a newly formed team supporting MSSP Revenue Acceleration as SentinelOne evolves its MSSP program, working closely with MSSP Revenue Assurance and MSSP Sales Leadership. Partnering across MSSP, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Legal, and IT, you will keep timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders aligned so initiatives land on time and with quality.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Track and monitor deliverables for the MSSP product transition strategy, defining key milestones and working cross-functionally to keep project timelines and deliverables on track.
Provide project management across MSSP revenue operations initiatives, including quote-to-cash, deal governance, forecasting, and partner lifecycle enhancements, in partnership with the MSSP Revenue Assurance team.
Support ad hoc special projects within MSSP, such as partnering with internal teams to unify capabilities and offerings within MSSP.
Selectively lead key large and strategic MSSP programs, ensuring timely delivery and quality.
Build and maintain the project management operating system for MSSP, including project plans, dependency maps, and a status reporting cadence that gives leadership real-time visibility into active initiatives.
Evaluate and, where needed, suggest processes that anticipate, identify, and mitigate potential issues, and coach teams on risk, dependency, and stakeholder management practices.
Foster strong cross-functional collaboration across MSSP, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Legal, IT, and other teams, breaking down silos and encouraging open communication.
Regularly review and redefine key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success and impact of projects.
Develop and deliver dashboards and analytics to track project status, metrics, and milestones.
Keep abreast of the latest industry trends, tools, and best practices, ensuring the organization is prepared for scale.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

5 or more years of progressive experience working in MSSPs, enterprise software, cybersecurity, or the technology industry.
Project management experience within partner operations, sales operations, or partner experience functions.
3 or more years of experience creating dashboards and visualizations, including SQL, data aggregation, and AI tooling such as Claude.
Experience with project management tooling, such as Asana, Jira, and Google Workspace.
Technical aptitude paired with a strong understanding of the business side, ensuring a holistic approach.
The ability to articulate complex ideas clearly, driving requirements and projects with global, diverse teams.
Strong relationship-building skills across organizational levels, with expertise in managing diverse stakeholder expectations and a proven track record of making informed decisions and standing firm when necessary to drive project success.
Familiarity with risk management processes and strategies that keep projects proceeding smoothly.
The ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously, using data and metrics to inform decisions, measure success, and identify areas for improvement.
Prior technical program management experience in SaaS or a technical domain is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. Description:
The Program Manager Customer Success position is expected to bring value at the strategic level to both Century and our customers by utilizing their extensive knowledge of Century’s supply chain operations and IT solutions provided. The Program Manager Customer Success is directly involved in the operational oversight, customer management, IT project development, and on-going support of VIZIV® and the various modules of VIZIV ®; all focused on the end goal of delivering a superior supply chain solution to our customers. This position is the front line in Century’s efforts to establish a superior reputation for customer service.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES: 

CORPORATE SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
Be a leader within the organization, assisting other departments (SCEs, NAST, ASRs, and Century Origin Offices) to improve overall team knowledge, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Be a leader for external customers, providing superior customer service, knowledge, and account management to assigned customers. Assist Century in meeting the company’s mission to create the most responsive and customized logistics services available in the market.  
Take an account ownership approach of the assigned customers, ensuring high customer satisfaction and account retention.
Provide leadership in developing and maintaining best practice solutions and long-term strategy in the area of supply chain operations to allow Century to achieve a competitive advantage in the industry.
If applicable, attend targeted seminars, courses, workshops, and/or industry events pertaining to the function. 
Attend and provide insight/suggestions to IT/Development on possible improvements or options to produce a more efficient product.  
Take on special projects as needed or requested.
Do not be bound by a specific role or job function. Take the initiative to address or solve problems to achieve highest possible customer satisfaction.
OPERATIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT 
Visit prospective and/or existing customers on a regular basis to review their supply chains and to make suggestions to improve workflow and efficiency. 
Identify customer pain points, recurring issues, black holes or manual processes and then find ways to further streamline through VIZIV use or other integration points.
Review the operational processes and SOP to ensure they are current and in line with the overall goals of the account. When necessary, work with your team to make changes or updates to the SOP.
Ensure customer addendums are current and updated where and when necessary.
Manage/lead regular calls with customer to stay abreast of all operational and/or system issues as well as opportunities. Assist in the creation and maintenance of customer roadmaps for the accounts you are involved with. 
Where necessary, engage the origin team (Ops Leads, ACMs, Management) to address ongoing issues.
Escalate critical operational issues to the Senior Manager Customer Success or Sales to ensure action plans are outlined and implemented.
Prepare material and/or agenda items (where requested), attend and present at customer meetings/QBRs.
Communicate results of each meeting to the teams directly involved with the account. 
Maintain and enhance relationships with customer and service provider contacts in efforts to build Century’s reputation for service quality. 
Where applicable, look for revenue opportunities with your assigned accounts, whether those be physical (CDDS/CEXQ/CDSB) or IT related.
IT PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT / SYSTEM SUPPORT AND CONFIGURATION / CUSTOMER DELIVERABLE
Identify new process or system requirements from both internal and external customers and design process and IT solutions that address these requirements. 
Receive customer requests for new features, reports, modules, or enhancements to system.  
Clearly document the goal of the project and create a Project Scope/Process Map/Statement of Work/Expectations document (using Century methodology and project standards) for signoff. Where needed, create ROI or SOW documents to gain approval for a project.
Create Projects, tasks, including detailed and proper specs and timelines to meet each customer requirement accounting for internal resources. Identify any gaps or risks where necessary.
Manage customer project lists to ensure deliverables clear, prioritized, and are achieved. Follow-up with customers after any new features or enhancements are implemented to ensure the requested change(s) are satisfactory.
Create all associated documentation for training, support, etc.
Identify and resolve complex technical problems without supervision. Where not able to resolve, create clear Help Desk tickets for resolution. Monitor and close tickets where applicable.
Manage customer configuration and views to meet customer demands, including grid admin, MPP, PEP, and database tools.
Understand customer interfaces, provide details on issues, check internal back-end systems (i.e. extol) to investigate and resolve where possible. Spec changes to existing or map out new interface demands.
Recognize critical issues and prioritize time and tasks accordingly to ensure as little customer workflow disruption as possible.
Continually improve your knowledge of the underlying database and code structure to improve your ability to communicate detailed technical requirements and plans to the development, database and reporting teams, but also to be able to resolve issues more quickly and independently.
STAFF MANAGEMENT
Manage assigned staff and communicate clear objectives and expectations; monitor progress and minimizes conflicts.
Meet often with your team to ensure all parties are aligned with current goals, projects, and issue resolution plans. If remote, visit HQ regularly.
Ensure your team is properly completing assigned duties and tasks directly relating to the account management.  
Provide back-up support (technical/operational/etc) where necessary.
Provide Account Support Staff with constructive feedback, both positive and negative.
Train and share knowledge and expertise with the other team members to fully understand all the features, processes and workflows in VIZIV®. Communicate and provide direct reports with technical and operational, training, and guidance.  
Groom your staff to continue learning and growing in their current role. Effectively motivate staff to achieve their maximum potential. Make recommendations on future staff roles and advancement.
Ensure team members are well utilized on highest priority issues. Identify non-essential work which is impacting their productivity and find ways to automate, shift, or improve the efficiency of the team without impacting customer satisfaction.
Make resource recommendation to the Director, Customer Strategy and Senior Manager Customer Success.
Prepare and review with the Director, Customer Strategy and Senior Manager Customer Success Annual Performance Appraisal for direct reports. Delivers Reviews to staff.
TEAM CONTRIBUTION
Foster a positive working environment by actively demonstrating an attitude of collaboration, teamwork and quality.
Be the chief knowledge officer when it comes to your customers, systems, and key operational processes.
Establish a tone of cooperation and sharing ensuring that actions are guided first and foremost by our mission and value statements. Facilitate effective team interaction.
Acknowledge and appreciate each team member’s contributions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

jobs.description:
In a changing world, unprecedented challenges require unmatched talent. Join one of Montreal’s Top Employers in 2025. We are a dynamic and growing organization having its main establishment located in downtown Montreal and part of a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future. Note that the position may be in the Canadian Branch of BNP Paribas or in one of its subsidiaries based in Montreal.

The position at a glance

The role consists in coordinating / driving the remediation of Major Findings and key Internal Programs to reinforce our IT and Cyber procedures, governance & control framework among IT & Cyber departments within CIB Americas. This is a unique opportunity to work with a wide range of technology and business experts, to learn about IT Development, IT Production and Information Security best practices.

In detail

The team member will be responsible for the following activities:

Review the requirements and/or identified findings and, in collaboration with the owner/implementation manager, define a remediation plan based on the assigned deadlines
Present the remediation plan to senior management and obtain validation from the sponsors
Drive the delivery of the remediation plans while updating ITO management with appropriate status reports highlighting key risks & issues.
Meet with the stakeholders regularly and continuously check and challenge the deliverables from IT/IS in line with the validated requirements.
Prepare the final report or submission ensuring all evidence is complete and in line with the initial requirements, and coordinate the validation of the remediation and associated deliverables with the appropriate stakeholders
Prepare the project closure with a recap of risks and control framework and communicate to Management.
Analyze any relevant external standards and practices (i.e. FFIEC, NIST) to improve and propose enhancements to our internal frameworksContribute to the development and maintenance of local standards and methodologies for CIB Americas IT and Cyber

Staff supervision / Organizational Structure:

The Americas ICT Risk & 1LoD Reviews department covers 2 main areas:

ICT Risk Management in charge of ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Monitoring & Reporting, and Regulatory exam support.
ICT Controls, Assurance & Audit in charge of Audit coordination and Control assurance

The department reports to CIB AMERICAS ITO CCCO, and the team is fully integrated covering Americas scope across 2 locations in the US (Jersey City, NJ) and Canada (Montreal). This position is within the ICT Risk Management department, under the Remediation delivery & Regulatory exam support team.

Bachelor or Master of Science / Engineering, ideally in computer science
Any of the CRISC, CISA, CIA, CISM, CISSP, PMP Certifications are valued.
Minimum of five (5) years recent experience in Information Technology audit or IT/Cyber Risk & Control/GRC

Ability to coordinate across multiple tasks and teams
Ability to work independently, in a fast-paced environment and under pressure

Ability to demonstrate tactical and strategic thinking, innovation, and creativity
Exceptional analytical abilities and attention to detail (i.e., examine large volumes of data)
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel / PowerPoint / SharePoint / PowerBI / Power Automate.
Given the vast majority of our clients, both internal and external, are based outside of Quebec and Canada, specific language requirements may apply. Professional working proficiency in English language is required.

In addition to competitive compensation, we offer flexible benefits including a family and spouse insurance program, a defined contribution pension plan and paid days for volunteering. Hybrid work arrangements are available for most positions. In-office presence is required a minimum of 3 days per week, one of which must be on a Monday and/or a Friday. BNP Paribas provides excellent training and personal development programs, as well as opportunities for career development within the company and internationally.

lead and motivate cross-functional teams to successfully deliver customer projects
take full ownership of project delivery including scope, budget, timeline, risks and quality

collaborate closely with customers to understand business needs and translate them into technology solutions

proactively ensure the highest quality standards in all project deliverables and drive continuous improvement
identify, scope and deliver technology and innovation services that create measurable business value for our customers
support presales activities by contributing project expertise, estimates and delivery concepts when needed

jobs.title: Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Circle is looking for a Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager to drive our licensing applications from filing strategy through to approval. Every new license, registration, or charter is a multi-month program on a regulatory clock, and it pulls in work from teams across the company. You will have early visibility into sensitive business and regulatory decisions. Handling that information with discretion is a core part of the role.

This is a program management role that requires real regulatory depth. You will run several applications at once and set the standard every future one follows. Regional policy and legal leaders own the strategy and the regulator relationship; you make the program move. In practice that means deciding what happens in what order, putting a name against every task, and getting the executive steering committee what it needs before it meets. We use AI heavily on this team and expect you to do the same. It is how a portfolio this wide stays manageable.

You will see every market Circle is considering before the decision is made, and you will be in the room with the people making it. How this function works is largely yours to define, and you will do it as an individual contributor leading by influence.

What You'll Work On

Supporting Circle's licensing applications end-to-end, from the case for entering a market through to approval, running several programs at once.
Building the program plan for each market – sequencing, dependencies, owners, dates – and holding it as the plan everyone works from.
Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, People & Workplace, and others to turn regulatory requirements into executable plans.
Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.
Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.
Defining and managing the reporting and metrics that give senior leadership and cross-functional partners an accurate, up-to-date picture of every market in the portfolio.
Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.
Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.
Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.
Serving as the go-to for program management across the global policy organization, setting the standard for how programs are run and helping team members strengthen their approach to planning, communication, and execution.

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 4 years supporting regulatory, licensing, legal or compliance work at a financial services, fintech or similarly regulated company.
Direct involvement in at least one licence, registration, or charter application, from early requirements to submission, or in a regulatory examination or remediation carried end to end.
Experience delivering complex, multi-month programs with many dependencies and a deadline you do not control.
The ability to hold senior colleagues to commitments you have no authority to enforce, and to raise a risk before it is comfortable to do so.
Daily, practical use of AI in your own work. You reach for it first on research, analysis, and internal reporting, and you know where a person still has to check the output.
A track record of building with AI, not only prompting it. You have shipped reporting workflows, automations, or internal tools that other people use, in environments like Claude, Vibebox or equivalent.
Strong written communication. You can turn a large set of inputs into a one-page status that an executive can act on.
The discipline to follow a requirement all the way to close, and sound judgment with confidential and privileged material.
Flexibility on working hours to support licensing and regulatory activity across time zones, from regular engagement with regulators in other regions to occasional deadline- or regulator-driven demands outside normal business hours.
Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

Preferred Requirements

Familiarity with the regulatory questions specific to stablecoins and digital assets: reserve composition and attestation, redemption, safeguarding of customer funds, and the payments, e-money and virtual asset regimes that govern them.
Experience working with one or more high-bar financial services regulators in any major jurisdiction.
Fluency in an additional language.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $140,000 - $170,000

We are an equal opportunity employer
. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, People & Workplace, and others to turn regulatory requirements into executable plans.
Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.
Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.
Defining and managing the reporting and metrics that give senior leadership and cross-functional partners an accurate, up-to-date picture of every market in the portfolio.
Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.
Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.
Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.
Serving as the go-to for program management across the global policy organization, setting the standard for how programs are run and helping team members strengthen their approach to planning, communication, and execution.

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 4 years supporting regulatory, licensing, legal or compliance work at a financial services, fintech or similarly regulated company.

The ability to hold senior colleagues to commitments you have no authority to enforce, and to raise a risk before it is comfortable to do so.
Daily, practical use of AI in your own work. You reach for it first on research, analysis, and internal reporting, and you know where a person still has to check the output.

jobs.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Department

The EHS team is responsible for collaborating with Construction, Operations, Contractors, Vendors, and various regulatory agencies to ensure the health, safety, and environmental risks of the company are protected and that everyone enjoys a safe and healthful workplace. At Vantage, health, safety, and environmental protection are a core value that guides everything we do. By leveraging every individual that works at Vantage to lean into safety initiatives, and by executing the executive mandate that Vantage will place safety at the forefront of everything we do, our employees and those we work with enjoy a safety culture that is deeply ingrained and expects excellence in safety. This excellence is achieved through constant vigilance, planning, training, measurement, and cooperation, all of which is aligned with operational and construction activities and goals.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Quincy, WA; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

The EHS Program Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving execution across the A&E portfolio of strategic initiatives. This role serves as the point of integration between functional strategy, project execution, business partnership, and workstream owners.

Working directly with the global EHS team, the Program Manager will translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, establish timelines, coordinate dependencies, monitor progress, and ensure accountability across multiple concurrent initiatives. The role does not own the technical or functional work itself, but instead ensures the right people, priorities, resources, and milestones remain aligned to deliver outcomes for the business.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills, influence without authority, strong stakeholder management capabilities, and advanced expertise in project management tools, such as ClickUp.

Essential Job Functions

Portfolio & Program Management

Partner with the Senior Director to develop annual, quarterly, and initiative-specific roadmaps.
Convert strategic objectives into structured work plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
Manage a portfolio of concurrent initiatives across Adoption & Enablement, including standards, communications, change management, analytics, systems enablement, contractor risk management, quality assurance, and future strategic programs.
Identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and schedule conflicts before they impact delivery.
Build executive-level portfolio presentations, dashboards, status reports, and progress updates.

Workstream Coordination

Coordinate execution across multiple workstream owners and subject matter experts.
Facilitate regular project reviews and accountability meetings.
Track commitments, decisions, actions, and deliverables.
Escalate barriers, delays, and risks to leadership when appropriate.
Ensure initiatives remain aligned to agreed scope, timelines, and business objectives.

Administration & Governance

Serve as the A&E team's primary power user and administrator of the project management software.
Design and maintain project templates, portfolios, dashboards, reporting structures, automations, and workflows.
Develop metrics and reporting that provide visibility into progress, workload, risks, and resource utilization.
Continuously improve project management processes through system optimization and automation.

Organizational Partnership

Act as the primary coordination point between A&E and business-sponsored programs.
Align A&E deliverables with broader organizational priorities and implementation schedules.
Support initiative planning, stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and execution readiness activities.
Work closely with portfolio leaders and business partners to integrate A&E support into enterprise transformation efforts.

Additional Duties:

Lead or support special projects, transformation initiatives, and operational improvement efforts that advance the goals of the EHS and Adoption & Enablement functions.
Perform other duties as assigned, including supporting new business priorities, organizational initiatives, team events and meetings, and strategic efforts as the function continues to evolve.

Success in this role looks like:

Establish a single portfolio management framework across all A&E initiatives.
Create executive-level visibility into initiative status, risks, and resource needs.
Improve project delivery predictability and milestone achievement.
Enable workstream owners to focus on execution while ensuring accountability and coordination are maintained.

Job Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental, Health and Safety or a related degree in Business, Project Management, Organizational Development, Operations, Engineering, or related field.

Experience:

5+ years of project, program, portfolio, or business operations management experience.
Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders.
Experience building and managing program roadmaps and enterprise-level implementation plans.
Experience supporting organizational change, transformation, or operational improvement initiatives.
Experience working with executive leadership and cross-functional business teams in a matrixed organization.

Skills:

Advanced experience in project management software (such as ClickUp) required.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Experience building status reports and executive presentations.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies and techniques.
Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.
Independent, self-directed, and highly organized.
Ability to manage complex, multi-track programs simultaneously.
Strong presence and communication skills in professional settings.
Operates effectively with ambiguity and change.
Familiarity with Procore & Power BI a plus.
Travel required is expected to be up to 5%.

Physical Demands And Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs or ladders; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Walking construction sites with unlevel, uneven and/or rocky surfaces, as well as being outside in weather conditions that may include heat, cold, and wind, for brief periods of time may be required. The use of Personal Protective Equipment may also be required, including wearing a hardhat, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety toed shoes, and additional outerwear.

Additional Details

Salary Range: $115,000 - $125,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

Oversees the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of concurrent projects spanning enterprise applications, business processes, systems integrations, data, and digital transformation initiatives. Partners with cross-functional stakeholders, DTT leaders, business leaders, vendors, and executive sponsors to align technology investments with organizational priorities. Manages program-level risks, dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple concurrent initiatives while guiding stakeholders through the full lifecycle of enterprise systems investments.

Accountabilities:

Manage a portfolio: Oversee enterprise systems initiatives and concurrent projects, maintaining roadmaps, plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and performance metrics across the full lifecycle — from business case through implementation, adoption, and operational transition.
Engage stakeholders: partner with business leaders, stakeholders, and technical teams to identify opportunities, define requirements, and prioritize initiatives; facilitate cross-functional discussions to build consensus on priorities, solutions, and implementation plans.

Manage vendors: oversee vendor relationships, contracts, and external service providers to support program outcomes.
Maintain documentation: establish and maintain project/program documentation, reporting, schedules, forecasts, and communication plans.

Strong leadership, facilitation, and communication skills, with a proven ability to guide diverse stakeholder groups through complex decision-making toward consensus.

Advanced knowledge of project/program/portfolio management methodologies, with the ability to translate complex technical and business information into actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

Provides teams with direction, feedback, and recognition, enabling cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing across stakeholder groups.

Bachelor's Degree or international equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.

PMP, PgMP, Agile, Prosci, Or Other Relevant Certifications Preferred.

Demonstrated proficiency with software development life cycle, third party software analysis and selection, including Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMi) or other structured software implementation standards.

Experience with portfolio governance, vendor management, strategic planning, and enterprise systems roadmaps.

Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
Ability to lift/move up to 5 lbs.

Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

10%

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager, Integrity, Risk, and Regulatory Operations
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the Role?

We’re looking for a Senior Business Operations Manager to help us run the Integrity, Regulatory, and Risk Operations organization and deliver its highest-priority cross-functional work. This role will lead the organization’s operating cadence, provide executive support to the Integrity, Risk, and Regulatory Operations leadership team, and lead projects with senior partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Operations.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a mix of business operations, executive support, and program leadership. We need someone who can move comfortably between preparing a business review, helping a leader make a decision, and driving a sophisticated program from planning through delivery.

This is a full time role reporting to the Senior Director of Risk, Fraud, & Financial Compliance.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Develop and Lead our Operating Cadence

Lead annual and quarterly planning, business reviews, all-hands meetings, leadership meetings, and other recurring forums.
Prepare clear agendas, pre-reads, updates, and decision materials; bring together decisions and make sure follow-ups have clear owners and outcomes.
Maintain a practical view of priorities, risks, dependencies, and commitments for the org.
Improve recurring processes so leaders and teams spend less time assembling information and more time making decisions and delivering results.

Support the Leadership Team

Help the leadership team schedule and prepare for important meetings, decisions, and communications.
Synthesize input from across the organization into concise recommendations, talking points, updates, and follow-up plans.
Keep leadership commitments moving across multiple teams and workstreams.
Handle critical information with discretion and sound judgment.

Lead large cross-functional programs

Own large programs from problem definition through planning, execution, launch, and post-launch improvement.
Define the program’s goals, scope, outcomes, owners, measures of success, and decision process.
Work with partners to align priorities, resolve tradeoffs, handle dependencies, and keep execution moving without relying on formal authority.
Partner with Analytics and operational teams to establish baselines, measure results, and adjust the approach when the data points to a better path.
Identify risks early, recommend practical mitigation plans, and raise decisions when needed.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

Significant experience in program management, business operations, strategy, chief-of-staff, consulting, or a related field.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with senior partners and multiple dependencies.
Experience in a technology, marketplace, payments, risk, regulatory, compliance, Trust & Safety, or operations environment is helpful.
Strong written and verbal communication, able to turn complex information into clear recommendations and decisions.
Excellent organization and follow-through, with the ability to handle details while keeping sight of the larger goal.
Good judgment when handling sensitive information and navigating ambitious priorities.
Comfort influencing without authority and working through ambiguity or changing priorities.
Experience partnering with Analytics or other technical teams to measure progress and impact.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, understand our priorities, stakeholders, decision forums, and current operating gaps; run key recurring forums and have started a first major project.
By 3 months, our planning and business-review cadence is predictable, useful, and trusted by leaders, with clearer priorities, owners, risks, decisions, and follow-through.
Within year 1, you have delivered a significant outcome through a major cross-functional program and improved at least one mechanism that makes the organization more effective and scalable.

If you like making complex work clearer and helping teams deliver important results, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.
