new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking a Lifecycle Project Manager- Power & Energy (Remote)
for our Power & Energy Program Management Team in Cottonwood Heights, UT. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical, schedules, quality, and financial aspects of Power and Energy Transmission and Distribution lines, Substation, and Communications site projects with a focus on SCADA and Telecomm as well as managing and developing client relationships. Responsible for the overall performance of assigned project(s) that are of moderate size/complexity and/or local/regional in scope, and includes oversight for financial, technical, client satisfaction, quality, safety, and schedule. Ensures that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable corporate standards for safety, execution, profitability, and operational purpose.

Your Impact

Oversee and monitor the planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout of multiple concurrent transmission line and substation projects of significant size, complexity, and strategic importance.
Provide senior-level project management oversight for scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, risk, procurement, construction readiness, commissioning, and project closeout activities.
Serve as the primary point of accountability for project delivery, proactively identifying issues, driving decisions, escalating risks, and ensuring alignment with client expectations, contractual requirements, and WSP standards.
Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated project schedules, cost forecasts, performance metrics, and executive-level reporting to support transparent decision-making and portfolio visibility.
Manage project financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, earned value analysis, change management, invoice review, cost control, and margin protection.
Lead client engagement and relationship development through proactive communication, issue resolution, strategic alignment, and consistent delivery of high-quality project outcomes.
Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, project controls, procurement, construction, environmental, permitting, vendors, contractors, and client stakeholders.
Establish and maintain project governance practices, including risk registers, decision logs, action tracking, change control, contract compliance, quality reviews, and audit-ready documentation.
Guide technical review requirements, resource planning, staffing assignments, and QA/QC expectations to ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, timely, and aligned with project objectives.
Mentor project managers, assistant project managers, and project team members by sharing best practices, reinforcing accountability, and supporting consistent project delivery across the program.
Exercise sound judgment and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, client commitments, and project conduct while adhering to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business and client needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, or a related field within the Power & Energy market; equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
7+ years of relevant post-education experience, including significant project management responsibility within the Power Delivery, transmission, substation, utility, or related infrastructure industry.
Demonstrated experience managing medium to large, complex transmission line and/or substation projects for electric utility clients, including investor-owned utilities, cooperatives, municipal utilities, independent power producers, or similar organizations.
Sound understanding of project delivery process within the A/E/C industry and well-defined background and experience in project management.
Well-developed analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Competent critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally.
Demonstrated high-level of self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently with minimal oversight and provides guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Competent with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating resources and assertively directing consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, and others to complete tasks competently and efficiently.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.
Ability to travel periodically to WSP offices, client offices, project sites, or other locations as required by project and business needs.
This position is subject to and contingent upon client approval of candidates put forth for consideration by WSP.

Preferred Qualifications

Masters Degree

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $125,000 - $182,000

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

Description:
The Program Manager Customer Success position is expected to bring value at the strategic level to both Century and our customers by utilizing their extensive knowledge of Century’s supply chain operations and IT solutions provided. The Program Manager Customer Success is directly involved in the operational oversight, customer management, IT project development, and on-going support of VIZIV® and the various modules of VIZIV ®; all focused on the end goal of delivering a superior supply chain solution to our customers. This position is the front line in Century’s efforts to establish a superior reputation for customer service.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES: 

CORPORATE SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
Be a leader within the organization, assisting other departments (SCEs, NAST, ASRs, and Century Origin Offices) to improve overall team knowledge, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Be a leader for external customers, providing superior customer service, knowledge, and account management to assigned customers. Assist Century in meeting the company’s mission to create the most responsive and customized logistics services available in the market.  
Take an account ownership approach of the assigned customers, ensuring high customer satisfaction and account retention.
Provide leadership in developing and maintaining best practice solutions and long-term strategy in the area of supply chain operations to allow Century to achieve a competitive advantage in the industry.
If applicable, attend targeted seminars, courses, workshops, and/or industry events pertaining to the function. 
Attend and provide insight/suggestions to IT/Development on possible improvements or options to produce a more efficient product.  
Take on special projects as needed or requested.
Do not be bound by a specific role or job function. Take the initiative to address or solve problems to achieve highest possible customer satisfaction.
OPERATIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT 
Visit prospective and/or existing customers on a regular basis to review their supply chains and to make suggestions to improve workflow and efficiency. 
Identify customer pain points, recurring issues, black holes or manual processes and then find ways to further streamline through VIZIV use or other integration points.
Review the operational processes and SOP to ensure they are current and in line with the overall goals of the account. When necessary, work with your team to make changes or updates to the SOP.
Ensure customer addendums are current and updated where and when necessary.
Manage/lead regular calls with customer to stay abreast of all operational and/or system issues as well as opportunities. Assist in the creation and maintenance of customer roadmaps for the accounts you are involved with. 
Where necessary, engage the origin team (Ops Leads, ACMs, Management) to address ongoing issues.
Escalate critical operational issues to the Senior Manager Customer Success or Sales to ensure action plans are outlined and implemented.
Prepare material and/or agenda items (where requested), attend and present at customer meetings/QBRs.
Communicate results of each meeting to the teams directly involved with the account. 
Maintain and enhance relationships with customer and service provider contacts in efforts to build Century’s reputation for service quality. 
Where applicable, look for revenue opportunities with your assigned accounts, whether those be physical (CDDS/CEXQ/CDSB) or IT related.
IT PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT / SYSTEM SUPPORT AND CONFIGURATION / CUSTOMER DELIVERABLE
Identify new process or system requirements from both internal and external customers and design process and IT solutions that address these requirements. 
Receive customer requests for new features, reports, modules, or enhancements to system.  
Clearly document the goal of the project and create a Project Scope/Process Map/Statement of Work/Expectations document (using Century methodology and project standards) for signoff. Where needed, create ROI or SOW documents to gain approval for a project.
Create Projects, tasks, including detailed and proper specs and timelines to meet each customer requirement accounting for internal resources. Identify any gaps or risks where necessary.
Manage customer project lists to ensure deliverables clear, prioritized, and are achieved. Follow-up with customers after any new features or enhancements are implemented to ensure the requested change(s) are satisfactory.
Create all associated documentation for training, support, etc.
Identify and resolve complex technical problems without supervision. Where not able to resolve, create clear Help Desk tickets for resolution. Monitor and close tickets where applicable.
Manage customer configuration and views to meet customer demands, including grid admin, MPP, PEP, and database tools.
Understand customer interfaces, provide details on issues, check internal back-end systems (i.e. extol) to investigate and resolve where possible. Spec changes to existing or map out new interface demands.
Recognize critical issues and prioritize time and tasks accordingly to ensure as little customer workflow disruption as possible.
Continually improve your knowledge of the underlying database and code structure to improve your ability to communicate detailed technical requirements and plans to the development, database and reporting teams, but also to be able to resolve issues more quickly and independently.
STAFF MANAGEMENT
Manage assigned staff and communicate clear objectives and expectations; monitor progress and minimizes conflicts.
Meet often with your team to ensure all parties are aligned with current goals, projects, and issue resolution plans. If remote, visit HQ regularly.
Ensure your team is properly completing assigned duties and tasks directly relating to the account management.  
Provide back-up support (technical/operational/etc) where necessary.
Provide Account Support Staff with constructive feedback, both positive and negative.
Train and share knowledge and expertise with the other team members to fully understand all the features, processes and workflows in VIZIV®. Communicate and provide direct reports with technical and operational, training, and guidance.  
Groom your staff to continue learning and growing in their current role. Effectively motivate staff to achieve their maximum potential. Make recommendations on future staff roles and advancement.
Ensure team members are well utilized on highest priority issues. Identify non-essential work which is impacting their productivity and find ways to automate, shift, or improve the efficiency of the team without impacting customer satisfaction.
Make resource recommendation to the Director, Customer Strategy and Senior Manager Customer Success.
Prepare and review with the Director, Customer Strategy and Senior Manager Customer Success Annual Performance Appraisal for direct reports. Delivers Reviews to staff.
TEAM CONTRIBUTION
Foster a positive working environment by actively demonstrating an attitude of collaboration, teamwork and quality.
Be the chief knowledge officer when it comes to your customers, systems, and key operational processes.
Establish a tone of cooperation and sharing ensuring that actions are guided first and foremost by our mission and value statements. Facilitate effective team interaction.
Acknowledge and appreciate each team member’s contributions.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable corporate standards for safety, execution, profitability, and operational purpose.

Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams of technical professionals to execute project work on mid-level and/or multiple concurrent projects, including budgets, tracking hours and expenses, task completion, cost and quantities of materials/equipment/labor, deliverables, compliance documentation, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project(s) as defined in the contract.

Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner. Immediately communicate and escalate any project site Health & Safety or significant client issues to senior PM staff and leadership.
Participate in problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions to leadership and other stakeholders.

Coordinate closely with client representatives, internal delivery teams, functional leads, subcontractors, and external stakeholders to align priorities, clarify responsibilities, resolve issues, and support consistent execution across assigned work.
Monitor accounts receivable (AR) and unbilled revenue, working to address issues as needed. Work with the Procurement Department to closeout procurements and/or supplier agreements as appropriate.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with conducting and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Remain current in the latest Project Management techniques and practices (PMAP).
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
Essential project management certification required (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).
7 to 10 years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
Sound understanding of project delivery process within the A/E/C industry and well-defined background and experience in project management.
Well-developed analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Competent critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally.
Demonstrated high-level of self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment. Works independently with minimal oversight and provides guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Competent with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating resources and assertively directing consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, and others to complete tasks competently and efficiently.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Master’s Degree in Engineering

In a changing world, unprecedented challenges require unmatched talent. Join one of Montreal’s Top Employers in 2025. We are a dynamic and growing organization having its main establishment located in downtown Montreal and part of a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future. Note that the position may be in the Canadian Branch of BNP Paribas or in one of its subsidiaries based in Montreal.

The position at a glance

The role consists in coordinating / driving the remediation of Major Findings and key Internal Programs to reinforce our IT and Cyber procedures, governance & control framework among IT & Cyber departments within CIB Americas. This is a unique opportunity to work with a wide range of technology and business experts, to learn about IT Development, IT Production and Information Security best practices.

In detail

The team member will be responsible for the following activities:

Review the requirements and/or identified findings and, in collaboration with the owner/implementation manager, define a remediation plan based on the assigned deadlines
Present the remediation plan to senior management and obtain validation from the sponsors
Drive the delivery of the remediation plans while updating ITO management with appropriate status reports highlighting key risks & issues.
Meet with the stakeholders regularly and continuously check and challenge the deliverables from IT/IS in line with the validated requirements.
Prepare the final report or submission ensuring all evidence is complete and in line with the initial requirements, and coordinate the validation of the remediation and associated deliverables with the appropriate stakeholders
Prepare the project closure with a recap of risks and control framework and communicate to Management.
Analyze any relevant external standards and practices (i.e. FFIEC, NIST) to improve and propose enhancements to our internal frameworksContribute to the development and maintenance of local standards and methodologies for CIB Americas IT and Cyber

Staff supervision / Organizational Structure:

The Americas ICT Risk & 1LoD Reviews department covers 2 main areas:

ICT Risk Management in charge of ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Monitoring & Reporting, and Regulatory exam support.
ICT Controls, Assurance & Audit in charge of Audit coordination and Control assurance

The department reports to CIB AMERICAS ITO CCCO, and the team is fully integrated covering Americas scope across 2 locations in the US (Jersey City, NJ) and Canada (Montreal). This position is within the ICT Risk Management department, under the Remediation delivery & Regulatory exam support team.

The Strengths And Skills That Will Help You Succeed

Bachelor or Master of Science / Engineering, ideally in computer science
Any of the CRISC, CISA, CIA, CISM, CISSP, PMP Certifications are valued.
Minimum of five (5) years recent experience in Information Technology audit or IT/Cyber Risk & Control/GRC
Professional working proficiency in English language is required *
Knowledge and experience in IT & Cyber risk & controls
Knowledge of Information Technology and Information Security processes and practices within the financial services industry
Familiarity with FFIEC IT Examination Guidelines (e.g., Development and Acquisition IT Handbook) and other major Cyber and Risk management industry frameworks
Experience in managing high-end and strategic projects
Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, presentation) and presentation skills to develop and deliver informative progress reports and proposals to senior stakeholders
Ability to coordinate across multiple tasks and teams
Ability to work independently, in a fast-paced environment and under pressure
Ability to obtain buy‑in, align multiple leaders from different opinions, and mediate among SMEs to find the best suitable solution.
Ability to demonstrate tactical and strategic thinking, innovation, and creativity
Exceptional analytical abilities and attention to detail (i.e., examine large volumes of data)
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel / PowerPoint / SharePoint / PowerBI / Power Automate.
Given the vast majority of our clients, both internal and external, are based outside of Quebec and Canada, specific language requirements may apply. Professional working proficiency in English language is required.

Do you have a strong project management background, passion for problem-solving, and want to join one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you!

We are looking for a Senior IT Project Manager
who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving customers’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By merging data, cloud, AI and design with deep industry expertise, we create impactful yet intuitive digital solutions that empower people and move businesses forward.

With a global team of 7,000 colleagues and a team of 300 colleagues in DACH, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents.

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you play a key role in the successful delivery of our software projects and technology services. You act as the central link between customers, delivery teams and stakeholders, ensuring high-quality results from idea to implementation.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a
Senior IT Project Manager, you

lead and motivate cross-functional teams to successfully deliver customer projects
take full ownership of project delivery including scope, budget, timeline, risks and quality
define and continuously improve project methodologies, governance models and best practices to ensure reliable and efficient deliveries
collaborate closely with customers to understand business needs and translate them into technology solutions
contribute to defining technology roadmaps and solution architectures in cooperation with architects and technical experts
manage the end-to-end implementation of digital solutions, from planning and design through development, testing and go-live
proactively ensure the highest quality standards in all project deliverables and drive continuous improvement
identify, scope and deliver technology and innovation services that create measurable business value for our customers
support presales activities by contributing project expertise, estimates and delivery concepts when needed

Who We Are Looking For

At least 5 years of experience as an IT project manager
Experience in shaping and leading teams across multiple stages of the project delivery lifecycle
Experience and knowledge of Scrum or any other project management method
Know-how in delivering complex software projects with various internal and external stakeholders
Experience in developing RFP responses, project estimation, staffing and other pre-sales related activities
A consulting attitude and the ability to handle discussions in German and English

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. You are passionate about all tasks around project management: team building, planning, cost and budget handling and discussions with the customer. You drive execution passionately to add customer value and take ownership of your results and delivered quality. You will continue to both learn from, and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We also believe you have

relevant project management certifications, such as IPMA or PMI

We offer

A culture built on trust, collaboration and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Continuous professional development, knowledge sharing and international career opportunities
A laptop and smartphone for private use, health programs, team events, food vouchers, excellent public-transport connections, a contribution towards the Austrian Klimaticket, fresh fruit and further local benefits
The opportunity to work with experienced colleagues on meaningful projects while contributing your own ideas from day one

The monthly gross salary for this full-time position starts at € 4,611.00 in accordance with the Austrian IT collective agreement (ST2, "Regelstufe"). The final package will reflect your qualifications, relevant experience and current market standards.

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile - even if you do not meet every listed point. We would be happy to explore together whether this role and our team are a good match for you.

Interviews are held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply when the opportunity feels right. If you have questions about the role, please contact our recruitment team at careers.austria@tieto.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Locations:
Vienna, Linz, Graz or Berlin. Hybrid working is available; travel requirements depend on the customer and project phase

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

new_jobs.title: Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Circle is looking for a Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager to drive our licensing applications from filing strategy through to approval. Every new license, registration, or charter is a multi-month program on a regulatory clock, and it pulls in work from teams across the company. You will have early visibility into sensitive business and regulatory decisions. Handling that information with discretion is a core part of the role.

This is a program management role that requires real regulatory depth. You will run several applications at once and set the standard every future one follows. Regional policy and legal leaders own the strategy and the regulator relationship; you make the program move. In practice that means deciding what happens in what order, putting a name against every task, and getting the executive steering committee what it needs before it meets. We use AI heavily on this team and expect you to do the same. It is how a portfolio this wide stays manageable.

You will see every market Circle is considering before the decision is made, and you will be in the room with the people making it. How this function works is largely yours to define, and you will do it as an individual contributor leading by influence.

What You'll Work On

Supporting Circle's licensing applications end-to-end, from the case for entering a market through to approval, running several programs at once.
Building the program plan for each market – sequencing, dependencies, owners, dates – and holding it as the plan everyone works from.
Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, People & Workplace, and others to turn regulatory requirements into executable plans.
Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.
Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.
Defining and managing the reporting and metrics that give senior leadership and cross-functional partners an accurate, up-to-date picture of every market in the portfolio.
Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.
Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.
Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.
Serving as the go-to for program management across the global policy organization, setting the standard for how programs are run and helping team members strengthen their approach to planning, communication, and execution.

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 4 years supporting regulatory, licensing, legal or compliance work at a financial services, fintech or similarly regulated company.
Direct involvement in at least one licence, registration, or charter application, from early requirements to submission, or in a regulatory examination or remediation carried end to end.
Experience delivering complex, multi-month programs with many dependencies and a deadline you do not control.
The ability to hold senior colleagues to commitments you have no authority to enforce, and to raise a risk before it is comfortable to do so.
Daily, practical use of AI in your own work. You reach for it first on research, analysis, and internal reporting, and you know where a person still has to check the output.
A track record of building with AI, not only prompting it. You have shipped reporting workflows, automations, or internal tools that other people use, in environments like Claude, Vibebox or equivalent.
Strong written communication. You can turn a large set of inputs into a one-page status that an executive can act on.
The discipline to follow a requirement all the way to close, and sound judgment with confidential and privileged material.
Flexibility on working hours to support licensing and regulatory activity across time zones, from regular engagement with regulators in other regions to occasional deadline- or regulator-driven demands outside normal business hours.
Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

Preferred Requirements

Familiarity with the regulatory questions specific to stablecoins and digital assets: reserve composition and attestation, redemption, safeguarding of customer funds, and the payments, e-money and virtual asset regimes that govern them.
Experience working with one or more high-bar financial services regulators in any major jurisdiction.
Fluency in an additional language.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $140,000 - $170,000

We are an equal opportunity employer
. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

new_jobs.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Department

The EHS team is responsible for collaborating with Construction, Operations, Contractors, Vendors, and various regulatory agencies to ensure the health, safety, and environmental risks of the company are protected and that everyone enjoys a safe and healthful workplace. At Vantage, health, safety, and environmental protection are a core value that guides everything we do. By leveraging every individual that works at Vantage to lean into safety initiatives, and by executing the executive mandate that Vantage will place safety at the forefront of everything we do, our employees and those we work with enjoy a safety culture that is deeply ingrained and expects excellence in safety. This excellence is achieved through constant vigilance, planning, training, measurement, and cooperation, all of which is aligned with operational and construction activities and goals.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Quincy, WA; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

The EHS Program Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving execution across the A&E portfolio of strategic initiatives. This role serves as the point of integration between functional strategy, project execution, business partnership, and workstream owners.

Working directly with the global EHS team, the Program Manager will translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, establish timelines, coordinate dependencies, monitor progress, and ensure accountability across multiple concurrent initiatives. The role does not own the technical or functional work itself, but instead ensures the right people, priorities, resources, and milestones remain aligned to deliver outcomes for the business.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills, influence without authority, strong stakeholder management capabilities, and advanced expertise in project management tools, such as ClickUp.

Essential Job Functions

Portfolio & Program Management

Partner with the Senior Director to develop annual, quarterly, and initiative-specific roadmaps.
Convert strategic objectives into structured work plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
Manage a portfolio of concurrent initiatives across Adoption & Enablement, including standards, communications, change management, analytics, systems enablement, contractor risk management, quality assurance, and future strategic programs.
Identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and schedule conflicts before they impact delivery.
Build executive-level portfolio presentations, dashboards, status reports, and progress updates.

Workstream Coordination

Coordinate execution across multiple workstream owners and subject matter experts.
Facilitate regular project reviews and accountability meetings.
Track commitments, decisions, actions, and deliverables.
Escalate barriers, delays, and risks to leadership when appropriate.
Ensure initiatives remain aligned to agreed scope, timelines, and business objectives.

Administration & Governance

Serve as the A&E team's primary power user and administrator of the project management software.
Design and maintain project templates, portfolios, dashboards, reporting structures, automations, and workflows.
Develop metrics and reporting that provide visibility into progress, workload, risks, and resource utilization.
Continuously improve project management processes through system optimization and automation.

Organizational Partnership

Act as the primary coordination point between A&E and business-sponsored programs.
Align A&E deliverables with broader organizational priorities and implementation schedules.
Support initiative planning, stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and execution readiness activities.
Work closely with portfolio leaders and business partners to integrate A&E support into enterprise transformation efforts.

Additional Duties:

Lead or support special projects, transformation initiatives, and operational improvement efforts that advance the goals of the EHS and Adoption & Enablement functions.
Perform other duties as assigned, including supporting new business priorities, organizational initiatives, team events and meetings, and strategic efforts as the function continues to evolve.

Success in this role looks like:

Establish a single portfolio management framework across all A&E initiatives.
Create executive-level visibility into initiative status, risks, and resource needs.
Improve project delivery predictability and milestone achievement.
Enable workstream owners to focus on execution while ensuring accountability and coordination are maintained.

Job Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental, Health and Safety or a related degree in Business, Project Management, Organizational Development, Operations, Engineering, or related field.

Experience:

5+ years of project, program, portfolio, or business operations management experience.
Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders.
Experience building and managing program roadmaps and enterprise-level implementation plans.
Experience supporting organizational change, transformation, or operational improvement initiatives.
Experience working with executive leadership and cross-functional business teams in a matrixed organization.

Skills:

Advanced experience in project management software (such as ClickUp) required.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Experience building status reports and executive presentations.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies and techniques.
Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.
Independent, self-directed, and highly organized.
Ability to manage complex, multi-track programs simultaneously.
Strong presence and communication skills in professional settings.
Operates effectively with ambiguity and change.
Familiarity with Procore & Power BI a plus.
Travel required is expected to be up to 5%.

Physical Demands And Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs or ladders; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Walking construction sites with unlevel, uneven and/or rocky surfaces, as well as being outside in weather conditions that may include heat, cold, and wind, for brief periods of time may be required. The use of Personal Protective Equipment may also be required, including wearing a hardhat, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety toed shoes, and additional outerwear.

Additional Details

Salary Range: $115,000 - $125,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Systems Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Enterprise Systems Program Manager serves as a lead within Digital, Technology & Transformation (DTT), responsible for a portfolio of enterprise systems initiatives and strategic technology programs, with a focus on financial and HR applications, that support organizational objectives across multiple business functions. Oversees the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of concurrent projects spanning enterprise applications, business processes, systems integrations, data, and digital transformation initiatives. Partners with cross-functional stakeholders, DTT leaders, business leaders, vendors, and executive sponsors to align technology investments with organizational priorities. Manages program-level risks, dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple concurrent initiatives while guiding stakeholders through the full lifecycle of enterprise systems investments.

Accountabilities:

Manage a portfolio: Oversee enterprise systems initiatives and concurrent projects, maintaining roadmaps, plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and performance metrics across the full lifecycle — from business case through implementation, adoption, and operational transition.
Engage stakeholders: partner with business leaders, stakeholders, and technical teams to identify opportunities, define requirements, and prioritize initiatives; facilitate cross-functional discussions to build consensus on priorities, solutions, and implementation plans.
Serve as liaison: act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, DTT, and technical subject matter experts, ensuring business needs are clearly represented and communicated.
Track and control delivery: monitor status, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and issues, applying corrective actions to keep initiatives on track.
Ensure governance and compliance: align initiatives with organizational priorities, governance processes, enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and established methodologies.
Manage vendors: oversee vendor relationships, contracts, and external service providers to support program outcomes.
Maintain documentation: establish and maintain project/program documentation, reporting, schedules, forecasts, and communication plans.
Drive improvement: promote continuous improvement in systems, processes, and program management practices, while fostering collaboration, transparency, and accountability across teams and leadership.

Applied Knowledge & Skills:

Strong leadership, facilitation, and communication skills, with a proven ability to guide diverse stakeholder groups through complex decision-making toward consensus.
Expertise in program, portfolio, and governance management, strategic planning, and organizational change management, including stakeholder engagement.
Skilled in partnering with stakeholders to drive enterprise systems strategy, business process improvement, and systems lifecycle management (ERP, financial management, grants management, human capital management, and enterprise reporting).
Advanced knowledge of project/program/portfolio management methodologies, with the ability to translate complex technical and business information into actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

Problem Solving & Impact:

Facilitates business and technology decision-making across cross-functional stakeholder groups, driving alignment by identifying dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and impacts across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Analyzes complex business, process, and system challenges to recommend practical solutions aligned with organizational goals, resources, and operational needs, presenting options to leadership to support decisions on scope, schedule, resources, and investments.
Exercises independent judgment to manage program risks, resolve issues, and recommend corrective actions, balancing strategic objectives with operational realities to ensure successful delivery of enterprise systems programs.
Works independently, with limited supervision, managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple departments, and contributes to improvements in governance, project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and business processes through project management best practices.

Supervision Given/Received:

Oversees quality and successful delivery of assigned programs, resolving issues among project teams and stakeholders and recommending solutions to management as needed.
Monitors program and project budgets, and manages and coordinates resources across a matrixed organization, including business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners.
Manages contractor and vendor relationships, deliverables, and performance, and participates in resource planning and allocation to support organizational priorities.
Provides teams with direction, feedback, and recognition, enabling cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing across stakeholder groups.
Mentors project managers, analysts, and other team members on program management best practices, and contributes to staff development, recruitment, proposals, and other organizational initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager, Integrity, Risk, and Regulatory Operations
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the Role?

We’re looking for a Senior Business Operations Manager to help us run the Integrity, Regulatory, and Risk Operations organization and deliver its highest-priority cross-functional work. This role will lead the organization’s operating cadence, provide executive support to the Integrity, Risk, and Regulatory Operations leadership team, and lead projects with senior partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Operations.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a mix of business operations, executive support, and program leadership. We need someone who can move comfortably between preparing a business review, helping a leader make a decision, and driving a sophisticated program from planning through delivery.

This is a full time role reporting to the Senior Director of Risk, Fraud, & Financial Compliance.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Develop and Lead our Operating Cadence

Lead annual and quarterly planning, business reviews, all-hands meetings, leadership meetings, and other recurring forums.
Prepare clear agendas, pre-reads, updates, and decision materials; bring together decisions and make sure follow-ups have clear owners and outcomes.
Maintain a practical view of priorities, risks, dependencies, and commitments for the org.
Improve recurring processes so leaders and teams spend less time assembling information and more time making decisions and delivering results.

Support the Leadership Team

Help the leadership team schedule and prepare for important meetings, decisions, and communications.
Synthesize input from across the organization into concise recommendations, talking points, updates, and follow-up plans.
Keep leadership commitments moving across multiple teams and workstreams.
Handle critical information with discretion and sound judgment.

Lead large cross-functional programs

Own large programs from problem definition through planning, execution, launch, and post-launch improvement.
Define the program’s goals, scope, outcomes, owners, measures of success, and decision process.
Work with partners to align priorities, resolve tradeoffs, handle dependencies, and keep execution moving without relying on formal authority.
Partner with Analytics and operational teams to establish baselines, measure results, and adjust the approach when the data points to a better path.
Identify risks early, recommend practical mitigation plans, and raise decisions when needed.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

Significant experience in program management, business operations, strategy, chief-of-staff, consulting, or a related field.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with senior partners and multiple dependencies.
Experience in a technology, marketplace, payments, risk, regulatory, compliance, Trust & Safety, or operations environment is helpful.
Strong written and verbal communication, able to turn complex information into clear recommendations and decisions.
Excellent organization and follow-through, with the ability to handle details while keeping sight of the larger goal.
Good judgment when handling sensitive information and navigating ambitious priorities.
Comfort influencing without authority and working through ambiguity or changing priorities.
Experience partnering with Analytics or other technical teams to measure progress and impact.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, understand our priorities, stakeholders, decision forums, and current operating gaps; run key recurring forums and have started a first major project.
By 3 months, our planning and business-review cadence is predictable, useful, and trusted by leaders, with clearer priorities, owners, risks, decisions, and follow-through.
Within year 1, you have delivered a significant outcome through a major cross-functional program and improved at least one mechanism that makes the organization more effective and scalable.

If you like making complex work clearer and helping teams deliver important results, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

As a Supply Chain Program Manager in the Supply Chain Center of Excellence, you will work alongside some of the most experienced and accomplished minds across Western Digital's Supply Chain functions, while engaging with the newest and most cutting-edge ideas in the field. Your role is to bring the two together, combining proven expertise with emerging thinking so that they work in harmony and deliver results.

You will be awarded opportunities across the full spectrum of Supply Chain functions, engaging with established leaders in Logistics, Direct Procurement, Indirect Procurement, Planning, Risk and Resiliency, Operations and beyond. Rather than relying on authority, you will build consensus through influence and persuasion, grounded in both hard facts and qualitative insight. Success depends on strong dependency management, stakeholder alignment and clear communication across functions that may have other priorities.

How we Operate

These are the behaviors expected every day. They map to the WD Leadership Expectations and define the standard that this position role models for the wider team.

Own the outcome, not the tracker. The plan is an instrument. The measure is whether the ramp landed on time, at cost and at quality.
Champion clear decisions. Most Program delay is undecided, not unknown. Frame the choice, name the decider, get it made and record it.
Manage the seams. Functions are usually competent inside their own boundary. Programs fail between them, which is where the Program Manager works.
Escalate early with a recommendation. Raise it when there is still room to act, and bring the option you would choose.
Be direct and transparent about status. Green that turns red without warning destroys credibility permanently. Report what is, not what is hoped.
Influence without direct line authority. Nobody on the Program reports to you. Credibility, preparation and reliability are the only levers — build them deliberately.
Close the loop. A Program that ends without lessons captured has spent the organization’s learning and kept none of it

Key Responsibilities

Strong Program Management Skills

Integrated planning and governance. Own the master plan, milestones, dependencies, owners, RAID log and steering committee cadence across all workstreams, with an independent view of status.
Scope, schedule and budget control. Protect the baseline, manage change through a disciplined process, and keep the program on time and on budget.
Risk and decision management. Surface risks early, frame decisions with options and a recommendation, and record outcomes so they are not relitigated.
Run the Program cadence at the right rhythm for the phase
Maintain a single source of truth for Program status
Define and enforce entry and exit criteria at each gate

Program Portfolio Leadership and Team Development

Own a portfolio of supply chain Programs, including major ramps and transitions of high complexity
Lead, coach and develop the Program Managers running them, building advanced proficiency across the Program management toolkit
Set the Program management standard for the function: plans, cadence, gates, reporting and post-Program review
Frame executive decisions, manage complex risk and drive cross-functional alignment without authority

Stakeholder Alignment

Cross-functional alignment. Bring together Legal, Direct Materials, Indirect Procurement, Logistics, Sales, Finance and IT, each with different contract types, risk tolerances and priorities.
Balancing competing priorities. Reconcile Legal’s risk posture, Procurement’s efficiency goals and the business’s need for speed into decisions all parties can support.
Composure with difficult stakeholders. Remain calm, respectful and fact-based when challenged; depersonalize conflict and keep the focus on outcomes.
Earned trust and sponsorship. Involve skeptics early, give them a real voice in design, and use executive sponsors and escalation paths deliberately.

Cross-Functional Dependency Management

Map dependencies across Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Operations, Planning and suppliers
Track dependency status and drive owners to their commitments
Resolve cross-functional conflicts at the working level where possible
Escalate blocked dependencies with the decision required clearly stated

Risk and Decision Management

Maintain a live Program risk register with owners, mitigations and trigger points
Run scenario analysis on the risks that could move the Program
Frame decisions clearly: the choice, the options, the trade-offs, the recommendation, the decider
Track decisions and their rationale so they are not relitigated

Delivery and Adoption Discipline

Fit to standard. Champion out-of-the-box capability and challenge customization that adds cost and risk without clear value.
Testing and cutover. Lead system integration and user acceptance testing, data migration validation and a well-rehearsed go-live.
Adoption and value. Drive training, change champions and adoption metrics such as contract cycle time, and confirm the business case is realized.
Measure adoption and sustainment, and reinforce new behaviors until they become the way Western Digital works

Change management

Lead organizational change that turns new processes, tools and ways of working into lasting habits across the enterprise
Build a compelling case for change and inspire stakeholders at every level, from executive sponsors to frontline teams
Design adoption roadmaps with clear communication, training and engagement plans that bring people along, not just systems
Identify and empower change champions who carry new practices into their own functions and regions
Anticipate resistance early and turn skeptics into advocates through listening, evidence and quick wins

Executive Communication and Decision Framing

Report Program status honestly, concisely and consistently
Frame executive decisions with the choice, options, trade-offs and a recommendation
Run executive forums that produce decisions rather than updates
Manage expectations early rather than explaining misses afterwards
Executive communication. Deliver concise, candid status that lets sponsors act quickly and with confidence.
Governance. Run a structured governance process to include daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly core team and steering Committee meetings
Collateral development. Create update templates and work individually and with team members to create executive communication collateral

Program Analytics and Reporting

Build and maintain readiness and status dashboards
Use data rather than narrative to drive Program conversations
Track leading indicators, not just milestone completion
Adopt tooling, automation, and AI that reduce reporting effort

Post-Program Learning

Run honest post-Program reviews covering what worked and what did not
Convert lessons into process change with the relevant process owner
Share learning across the Program community
Improve templates, gates and standards based on what was learned

Business Process Transformation

Champion innovation by challenging how work is done today and envisioning how it should be done tomorrow
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and digitize end-to-end business processes across supply chain functions
Oversee transformation projects from concept through delivery, ensuring they meet scope, schedule and value commitments
Partner with IT and business owners to align process redesign with enabling systems, data and AI capabilities
Measure the impact of each transformation and feed the lessons into the next wave of improvement

What would success look like

Big bets that land. Bold programs and transformations delivered on time, on budget and at the quality customers expect.
Problems solved before they surface. Risks and gaps spotted early and closed well ahead of the moment they could hurt the business.
A supply chain ready for what's next. Capacity, capability and technology in place before demand arrives, not after.
Change without chaos. New processes, tools and transitions rolled out smoothly, with no disruption to customers and no value left on the table.
A voice leaders trust. Reporting so candid and reliable that there are never surprises, and status always reflects reality.
Decisions made in the room. Choices framed so clearly that leaders can act on the spot and keep momentum high.
A legacy that compounds. Every lesson turned into a lasting standard, so each program makes the next one faster, smarter and better.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business or a related field
10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations or program management, including leading product ramps, technology transitions or supplier readiness in a high-tech, semiconductor or electronics manufacturing environment
A track record of leading process improvement or transformation work with measurable results
Hands-on familiarity with AI and automation, including generative AI tools, and the curiosity to apply them to real supply chain problems
Organizational change management experience
Experience leading and developing Program Managers or cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to frame executive decisions and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
Strong working knowledge of supplier capacity, qualification, engineering change and end-of-life management
Proficiency with program analytics and dashboarding tools

Preferred

Master's degree or MBA
PMP, PgMP or ASCM (APICS) certification
Experience in data storage or hard disk drive supply chains
Delivering AI and machine learning use cases, such as predictive supplier risk, demand sensing and generative AI assistants
Experience with control towers, digital twins and supplier risk platforms
Setting up or maturing a Program Management Office, which ties to the next-generation PMO in the opening
Leading scenario planning, tabletop exercises or business continuity programs
A background in consulting, transformation offices or a center of excellence
Familiarity with sustainability, ESG and trade-compliance requirements
Working with global teams and Asia-based supplier networks
Change management certification (e.g., Prosci) or a record of leading large-scale adoption programs

Programs are where every part of the supply chain organization has to work as one. This role holds limited authority and all of the accountability, which makes credibility the entire currency of the role. Earn it by being prepared, being honest about status, and forcing the decisions nobody else wants to call.

In summary, the Program Manager is encouraged to bring innovation and creativity to every challenge, and fresh thinking about where the supply chain should go next will always be welcome. You will not be starting from a blank page: Western Digital is already pursuing a number of cutting-edge initiatives, and you will have the opportunity to shape, accelerate and expand them.

Program Strategy & Reporting

Provide executive-level status updates, highlighting progress, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Lead retrospective reviews and promote a culture of continuous improvement across teams.

12+ years of experience in program and project management, with at least 7 years of experience managing client-facing technical solutions.

Customer-facing experience with proven ability to translate client requirements into executable plans.

Success Metrics

Effective program delivery, with adherence to key milestones and client satisfaction.
Achievement of KPIs related to program success, including delivery timelines, budget adherence, and quality outcomes.
Continuous improvement in team processes, leading to enhanced efficiency, fewer defects, and faster delivery times.

This role is essential for driving successful client projects that require a balance of technical expertise, customer relationship management, and program leadership. The TPgM will be a key player in delivering scalable, high-quality solutions while ensuring that client needs are met and exceeded.

About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role

You'll turn data requirements into capture programs that work across devices, operators, and locations. You will lead the execution that lets Mecka expand real-world data collection while meeting demanding standards for quality and delivery. The role connects engineering decisions to the realities of recording in the field. That means validating pilots, understanding what makes output usable, and building plans that hold up as operations grow.

What You'll Do

Turn dataset requirements into capture programs with clear quality standards, capacity plans, and delivery milestones.
Coordinate device availability, operator training, recording capacity, and data review across a program.
Plan and validate pilot captures before expanding operations.
Investigate data-quality issues with engineering and operations teams, and verify that corrective actions work.
Use measured capacity and data acceptance rates to forecast delivery, identify risks, and adjust the plan.

What You Bring

Must-have:

Experience delivering technical programs that combine hardware, software, and field operations.
Ability to build practical schedules, map dependencies, and resolve technical blockers across teams.
Understanding of sensor data, calibration, synchronization, and common recording failures.
Skill in analyzing throughput, quality, capacity, and cost using spreadsheets, queries, or scripts.
Ability to inspect recordings and diagnostic logs, ask precise engineering questions, and verify that a fix works.
Clear written communication, including operating procedures, technical decisions, and realistic delivery forecasts.

Nice-to-have:

Experience with robotics datasets or recording programs involving several sensor types.
Experience improving operator workflows or automating data-quality checks.
