We are seeking an execution-focused, hands-on AI Project Manager to coordinate day-to-day operations across our regional AI portfolio, support the AI Center of Excellence (CoE), and guide early-stage AI solution lifecycles through execution. Reporting directly to the Head of AI and Analytics, this mid-level working role provides hands on operational and project management support across the entire initiative lifecycle from problem framing through industrialization.

The AI Project Manager will lead the initial phases of AI centric solutions, including MVP (Minimum Viable Product) definition and deployment strategies for scaling and industrializing Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. Additionally, this position concretely supports the Head of AI and Analytics in establishing and running the cross functional AI Working Committee to drive the North American AI strategy, partners with external consulting firms through SOW management to discover and evaluate high value use cases and facilitates delivery rhythms with technical data teams to bridge strategic goals and operational reality.

Your future duties and responsibilities

AI Solution Lifecycle, MVP Definition & Agile Delivery (40%)

Initial Phase Leadership & MVP Definition: Lead the initial phases of AI centric solutions, including MVP (Minimum Viable Product) definition and deployment strategies for scaling and industrializing Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across business functions.

End to End Delivery Support (Inception to Deployment): Partner with business domain leads, data scientists, and data engineers to guide initiatives from early problem definition and technical feasibility assessments through proof of concept (PoC) validation, establishing clear success metrics and business KPIs.

Agile Governance & Delivery Rhythms: Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, iteration reviews, and backlog refinement sessions within Agile/SAFe environments. Apply structured project controls managing scope, schedules, risks, and stage gate milestones in alignment with Airbus LBIP processes.
Transition to Operations & UAT: Define operational readiness criteria, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and prepare deployment instructions, training materials, and handover documentation to ensure seamless industrialization and long-term organizational adoption.

Vendor Engagements, SOWs & Consulting Support (30%)

Consulting Discovery & Use Case Identification: Partner with external consulting firms during discovery workshops to uncover, evaluate, and prioritize high value operational AI use cases across North American business domains.
Deliverable Review & Quality Assurance: Conduct structured technical and operational reviews of vendor outputs and deliverables, verifying alignment with contract criteria, business objectives, and enterprise data standards.
Budget & Milestone Governance: Monitor active consulting engagements against contracted scopes, tracking vendor billing milestones, burn rates, purchase orders, and deliverable timelines.

AI Working Committee, CoE Enablement & Strategy Support (25%)

AI Center of Excellence (CoE) Operations: Coordinate central AI CoE activities, including community forums, knowledge sharing webinars, AI tool access workflows, and best practice enablement across regional sites.
Portfolio Tracking & Pipeline Transparency: Maintain initiative intake pipelines, project dashboards, and milestone boards tracking AI initiatives from ideation to production.
Leadership Briefings & Reporting: Prepare executive briefing decks, steering committee alignment summaries, and progress scorecards for regular leadership governance.

Other duties as assigned.

Core Experience: 3 to 5 years of practical project management or project coordination experience within an enterprise IT, analytics, or software delivery environment.
AI Lifecycle & MVP Definition: Proven hands-on experience guiding or leading the initial phases of AI/ML or advanced analytics solutions, defining MVP boundaries, and coordinating technical teams through prototyping, testing, and rollout.

Delivery Methodologies: Practical experience managing project workflows using Agile/Scrum or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles alongside formal corporate stage gate controls.
